_comment: User-defined video-type presets. Copy to video-types.json (same dir) and edit. Each entry shallow-merges over the built-in of the same name (social-short, long-form, cinematic, tutorial, podcast, general); a NEW name becomes a new preset based on `general` and is selectable as a video_type intent answer or via VOB_VIDEO_TYPE. Run `vob_doctor` to see the resolved table. An unknown preset name always falls back to `general` — never an error.
_fields: platform_default: a canonical platform/profile name (incl. custom geometry names from render-profiles.json). editorial.clean_cut: snap cuts to filler/dead-air-free keep-spans (storyboarder) + straddle lint. lint_ruleset: retention | chaptered | montage | general. overlay_vocabulary: subset of title_card, lower_third, callout, kinetic_caption, caption_block, logo_bug, progress_bar, chapter_marker, section_title, data_viz, cta, end_card, pip. render.segmentation: single | auto | manual.

cinematic._comment_override_example: tweak a built-in: keep everything else, just turn captions-friendly overlays on
